mapper.select: SELECT * FROM generated_report WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATEDIFF(period_end, period_start) = 6 ORDER BY period_start DESC
SELECT * FROM generated_report WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATEDIFF(period_end, period_start) >= 27 ORDER BY period_start DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO generated_report (user_id, period_start, period_end, report_type, total_expense, total_income, net_amount, category_statistics, analysis_text, vector_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{reportType}, #{totalExpense}, #{totalIncome}, #{netAmount}, #{categoryStatistics}, #{analysisText}, #{vectorId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE generated_report SET report_type = #{reportType}, total_expense = #{totalExpense}, total_income = #{totalIncome}, net_amount = #{netAmount}, category_statistics = #{categoryStatistics}, analysis_text = #{analysisText}, vector_id = #{vectorId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
